graphite-violet.$description: Graphite Violet — Body text, default borders, icon strokes — near-gray with a cool violet undertone carries all secondary content

slate-gray.$description: Slate Gray — Muted body text, nav items, secondary button labels

mist.$description: Mist — Placeholder text, disabled input values, tertiary helper text

hairline.$description: Hairline — Input borders, dividers, secondary card borders

cloud.$description: Cloud — Card borders, soft shadow halos, light dividers — the primary neutral border for product surfaces

paper.$description: Paper — Card surface tint, section background wash — barely-there blue-white that warms the canvas without competing with content

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text, inverted text on dark — the dominant background

indigo-core.$description: Indigo Core — Primary CTA fill, active nav, key icon accents — the single vivid saturated accent that makes interactive elements feel switched on; Three-stop gradient for CTA hovers, premium dark accents, and feature highlights

indigo-glow.$description: Indigo Glow — Hover states, gradient midtones, secondary link color — the lighter step of the brand ramp; Three-stop gradient for decorative text effects, hero accents, and section dividers

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Light gradient start, soft tag fills, decorative wash — the pale end of the violet ramp for backgrounds

midnight-indigo.$description: Midnight Indigo — Headlines, dark hero panels, footer — near-black with violet depth, anchors dark sections and high-contrast typography

deep-indigo.$description: Deep Indigo — Badge text on light backgrounds, secondary heading color, dark UI text — a mid-step between midnight indigo and core indigo

forest.$description: Forest — Success badge text, positive state icons

mint-tint.$description: Mint Tint — Success badge background wash

ember.$description: Ember — Error badge text, destructive state icons

saffron.$description: Saffron — Warning/orange badge text — earthy orange-brown, not a bright alert orange

buttercream.$description: Buttercream — Warning badge background, soft warm highlight surface

g2-coral.$description: G2 Coral — Social proof badge accent (G2 review widget) — a single warm coral that breaks the cool palette for trust signals

basiersquare-webfont.$description: Single custom geometric sans used for everything from 12px body to 88px display. Weight 400 is the workhorse for body, nav, buttons, and small UI; weight 500 is reserved for headings, bold labels, and emphasis. The custom face's tight apertures and squared geometry are the brand's primary identity — substituting a standard sans will make the site look generic.
